title: Omega-3 Fatty Acid-Based Parenteral Nutrition Improves Postoperative Recovery for Cirrhotic Patients With Liver Cancer

sections.abstract: The safety and efficacy of ω-3 fatty acid in patients with liver cancer followed hepatectomy is not known. This study provided evidences that ω-3 fatty acid-based parenteral nutrition improved postoperative recovery for cirrhotic patients with liver cancer underwent hepatectomy..
